claims.claim: Eurogamer published a piece headlined: Witcher 3 Remastered patch addressing "various lighting adjustments" rolls out
claims.evidence: Since The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered's launch earlier this week, the debate around its lighting changes - whether it's overly brightened and washed out - has waged on. Now, CD Projekt Red has rolled out a patch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and the game's PC Xbox Play Anywhere version, which makes "various lighting adjustments" among other things. Read more

claims.evidence: CD Projekt have released the full list of PC system requirements for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered , a free upgrade for the base edition of the grizzled and cantankerous fantasy action-RPG. This covers both the previously announced minimum PC specs and the recommended, ultra, ray-tracing minimum, ray-tracing recommended, and path tracing configurations. Read more

claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that on 1 October CD Projekt Red released a patch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and the PC Xbox Play Anywhere version that made various lighting adjustments, including fixing interiors that appeared too dark, and fixed DLSS being unavailable in the Play Anywhere version.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 1 Oct 2026, with the listed changes. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer says debate over whether the Remastered edition is overly bright and washed out has continued since its launch, and points to the Bloom setting, which can be turned off on PC but not on console.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 1 Oct 2026. The Bloom point is the outlet's assessment. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer says the Remastered edition is free to everyone who already owns any version of the game and is preparing the ground for a third expansion, Songs of the Past, due next year.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 1 Oct 2026, final paragraph. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that a second hotfix, 5.00c, was released for PC on 2 October and directly addresses lighting concerns.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 2 Oct 2026, with patch notes. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
claims.quote: various visual adjustments in Velen, including tweaks to Bloom, vegetation lighting, saturation, and path tracing lighting

claims.claim: The 5.00c notes as listed by Eurogamer also fix saving and loading when the Documents path contains special characters, voiceover becoming quieter after using the pause menu, a HairWorks change that caused performance and visual problems, missing GOG achievements, and the Classic 1.32 version failing to launch.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 2 Oct 2026, patch notes. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: GamesRadar+ reports, citing SteamDB, that the game reached a new all-time Steam peak of 137,724 concurrent players, having passed 120,000 within hours of the remaster's launch; the previous record was 103,329 in January 2020.
claims.evidence: GamesRadar+, 5 Oct 2026, paragraphs 1-2. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: GamesRadar+ quotes Paweł Sasko, whom it describes as associate game director on the Cyberpunk 2077 sequel, thanking players.
claims.evidence: GamesRadar+, 5 Oct 2026, quoting his post. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
claims.quote: Much love and gratitude for playing our games

claims.claim: GamesRadar+ says the Remastered edition is currently the top-scoring game of 2026 on Metacritic.
claims.evidence: GamesRadar+, 5 Oct 2026. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that on 6 October CD Projekt Red said on X it is still working on further performance improvements, particularly on PS5, further visual adjustments, and voiceover audio fixes on consoles, and aims to address many of these in the next update.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 6 Oct 2026, paragraph 2. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
claims.quote: further performance improvements, particularly on PS5

claims.claim: Eurogamer says CD Projekt Red is working with mod.io to bring more mods to all platforms, cross-platform mod support having been added in the Remastered edition.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 6 Oct 2026. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer says parts of the community were aggravated that Twitch Drops and Ukrainian localisation were listed as work in progress while bugs remain, and that some PS5 players are asking for the previous next-gen version back; the game version can be rolled back on PC but not on console.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 6 Oct 2026, quoting player comments. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer notes the Remastered edition raises the game's minimum system requirements, and that CD Projekt Red had no comment when asked about the brightness complaints.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 6 Oct 2026. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
